baseline: Original Dijkstra ML4 absolute predicted nanoseconds plus 6.92658480142496 ns per recorded gshare misprediction
candidate: baseline + (10/496 ns) * loop_recurrence_cycles_x16; charge each solver and its reference before taking the ratio
basis: One physical cycle at 3.1 GHz per 16 recorded units. Incremental diagnostic, without fitting.
development_observation: The long maximum-subarray prefix/Kadane recurrence count ratio was already compared with native timing. All outcomes from the archived suites are historical.
scope: All registered groups, alternate solvers, inputs, and both boots in the listed archives. Report and explain any missing-field exclusion. Supplemental measurements of the same ELF/input are not new independent families.
reference: Compare exact candidate/reference ratios with the ratio of the two native sample medians; classify decisive thresholds using all native sample pairs; equality is accepted.
outputs: Per boot, family and pooled: paired baseline and candidate threshold outcomes, false accepts, false timeouts, native-mixed decisions, case count, median and worst absolute relative error and count within 20 percent. Separate each family including maximum subarray, which motivated the change. Report any new false decision.
criterion: On each boot, strictly reduce the pooled median absolute relative error without any new false decision on an individually decisive case/deadline. Also report each family and case regardless of outcome.
